hooks.name: Session End Documentation Check
hooks.description: Reminds AI agents to document feature requirements when a session ends after making significant changes

action.prompt:
Before this session ends, review if you made any changes that introduced:

- New npm/pip/system dependencies
- New environment variables
- New configuration files or settings
- New AWS services or infrastructure requirements
- New setup steps or commands

If YES to any of these, ensure the documentation was updated:
- Dependencies → README.md prerequisites or requirements.txt/package.json
- Env vars → .env.example files and README.md
- Setup steps → README.md or docs/SETUP.md

Provide a brief summary of documentation updates made (or needed).
